newsitem.title: USA: BPA withdraws on-peak displacement power for Mon.
newsitem.headline: BPA withdraws on-peak displacement power for Mon.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) withdrew its offer "market expansion" power for Monday during on-peak hours, the agency said Friday.

Market expansion, sold to buyers willing to displace thermal generation, was still offered during off-peak hours at $7.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for all deliveries on Monday and at $10.00 per MWh for on-peak hours on Saturday and Sunday.
BPA continued to offer standard firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Monday at $10.50-11.50, but non-firm power during peak hours on Monday was not offered.
Up to 500 megawatts of firm on-peak power was offered at $16.75 in the Northwest, up from $15.25 for Friday, and at $17.75 at the California-Oregon border (COB), up from $16.25.
Off-peak firm prices were unchanged at $10.50 for all delivieres.
